correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly reduces each two-step gcd to gcd(2k+1,s(u)-s(u+1)); this identity follows from Reznick Corollary 2.4 and coprime consecutive Stern terms. Reznick Theorem 4.7 establishes the required fixed-modulus uniform distribution. CRT counts the congruent primitive pairs exactly, a geometric series sums the run-length density, and a uniform exponential tail validates density limits and absolutely convergent Möbius inversion. The finite checker has passed all 262144 lag-two instances and CRT ratios for d<100; these checks do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial neighboring Stern gcd (lag two, vs identically coprime lag one) has a complete and nondegenerate natural distribution. All odd gcd values occur with positive frequencies, even values never occur, divisibility has an explicit product law, and exact-value probabilities arise from an exponentially convergent Möbius series. These are specific natural arithmetic invariants, not arbitrary finite slices.
